insight: Released by LangChain in February 2025; MIT-licensed and integrates natively with LangGraph's long-term memory store.
name: LangMem
tagline: Long-term memory SDK that lets agents learn and adapt over time.
description: A memory toolkit for AI agents that extracts and stores facts from conversations and refines agent behavior through prompt updates. Exposes semantic, episodic, and procedural memory via a storage-agnostic core API plus tools agents can call during or after a conversation.
edge: Backed by LangChain, it ships semantic/episodic/procedural memory tools that plug straight into LangGraph rather than a standalone store.
cons: Most value inside the LangChain stack
You wire up your own storage layer

references.title: LangMem SDK for Agent Long-Term Memory
